result:
I would remove the fear that telling the truth will make you less lovable.

If people could say what they really believe, see, and feel without being punished by shame, exclusion, or violence, then much of what harms the world would become much harder to sustain. Lies, cruelty, and manipulation often survive because silence is safer than honesty.

So one change: make truth less costly than deception.
